That points to further downside risks for NZD vs commodity currency peers, despite potential near-term relief in the undervalued NZD/USD

week.title: Bank of Japan hits 2% price target
week.desc: ASIA/PACIFIC: In a big day for monetary policy in Japan, the Bank of Japan finally announced it had hit its 2% price target – a target set in 2013.
